definitions.explanation: The time at six hours past midnight or noon.

examples.japanese: {六時|ろくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I wake up at six o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六時|ろくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わります→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{六時|ろくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きなければ→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦なりません→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I have to wake up at six o'clock tomorrow morning.

notes:
{六時|ろくじ} is the standard way to say "six o'clock." Six o'clock is notable as a common reference point for daily routines — morning wake-up and evening end of work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{六時|ろくじ}: 6 a.m.
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧{六時|ろくじ}: 6 p.m.
- {六時半|ろくじはん}: 6:30
- {六時|ろくじ}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: exactly 6 o'clock
- {六時|ろくじ}{過|す}ぎ: past six o'clock
- ⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧{六時|ろくじ}: 6:00 AM (formal)

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading is ろくじ. Unlike some numbers that change pronunciation before counters (e.g., ⟦{六|ろっ}{百|ぴゃく}→六百：30450_roppyaku⟧), ⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ keeps its full form before ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧.
